gloss: to wear out; to fray; to become threadbare

definitions.gloss: to wear out; to fray; to become threadbare
definitions.explanation: for fabric, rope, or similar materials to become worn or frayed through friction or repeated use

examples.japanese: ズボンの{膝|ひざ}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The knees of my pants wore through.

examples.japanese: {靴下|くつした}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れて{穴|あな}が{開|あ}いた。
examples.english: My socks wore out and got holes in them.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{読|よ}んだので{本|ほん}の{背表紙|せびょうし}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れている。
examples.english: The book's spine is worn from being read so many times.

notes:
{擦|す}り{切|き}れる describes things wearing thin or through from friction or repeated use. A compound verb from {擦|す}る (to rub) + {切|き}れる (to break/snap).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {擦|す}り{切|き}る (transitive — to wear something out)
- Pattern: 〜が{擦|す}り{切|き}れる

ASPECT (ている):
- {擦|す}り{切|き}れている: is worn out (resulting state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴下|くつした}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: socks wear out
- ズボンの{膝|ひざ}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: pants knees wear through
- {本|ほん}の{背表紙|せびょうし}が{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: book spine wears out
- ロープが{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: rope frays through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {破|やぶ}れる: to tear, to rip
- {傷|いた}む: to become damaged
- {古|ふる}びる: to become old/worn looking
